title: variant.release, contract version 2
description: Releases a revision of any variant of an entry (PRD 5.6, 6.4, 10.3): the entry, the variant, the shared one or a language's, the number of the revision to release and the version of the variant the caller read. A variant at another version is version_conflict, and a language's release is authorized in its locale and the shared variant's in every locale. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Entries\Domain\Commands\ReleaseEntryVariant, and the generated codec ReleaseVariantCodecV2 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

revision.description: The number of the revision to release.

variant.description: The variant to release a revision of.

version.description: The version of the variant the caller read.

revision.description: The number of a revision of a variant, an integer of 1 or more.

variant.description: A variant of the entry: shared, the variant that holds the fields that do not vary by language, or the language tag of a language's variant, such as da or en-GB.

version.description: The version of an aggregate that the caller read, an integer of 1 or more; the command is version_conflict when the aggregate is at another version when it commits.
